about: Places of the Backpack Space world: planets, moons, comets, belts, stations and stars. Every entry is a draft until Ilja confirms it. Items and heroes link to the place they come from; one item has at most one origin. Edit here, then run npm run lore (writes lore/graph.html) and npm run validate.

places.name: Rime
traits: a sun too far away to warm it
places.life: Large slow animals with ice grown into their coats, wide flat feet for the frozen seas, big pale eyes for the dark.
places.background: A flat sea of cracked blue-black methane ice under a tiny pale sun; frost ridges, a herd silhouette far away.

places.name: Cinder
places.life: Animals with cracked basalt skin and rust-red heat in the cracks; food that is spicy enough to smoke.
places.background: Black basalt plates split by rust-red lava rivers, steam drawn as wavy ink lines, a dark red sky.

places.name: The Drift
places.life: Light, long-legged animals that leap from comet to comet, trailing dust like comet tails.
places.background: Tumbling comets of dirty ice with long dust tails across a dark sky.

places.name: Ochre
places.life: Flat, armoured animals with short thick legs; shells and armour of layered sandstone.
places.background: Low red sandstone mesas in flat layers under a heavy brown sky; nothing stands tall.

places.name: Thinwind
traits: dry desert with very thin air
places.life: Small round burrowers with frilly breathing gills that hoard shiny ore pebbles.
places.background: Pale dunes full of glinting ore pebbles, burrow holes, a dusty mustard sky.

places.name: Gemell
places.life: Night insects whose markings repeat the two moons.
places.background: A pale twilight forest under two crescent moons, moths drifting between the trees.

places.name: Pell
places.life: Station cooks claim its craters ripen the best moon cheese.
places.background: A pocked pale moon, close enough to see every crater, with a few crumbs in orbit.

places.name: The Scrap Belt
places.life: Miners, salvage robots and burrowing animals that live inside asteroids.
places.background: Asteroids and broken hulls tumbling together, a mining tether between two rocks.

places.name: The Garden Station
traits: research station that bred crops for open vacuum
places.life: Venn and everything that grew from it; the botanist's old drone.
places.background: A station ring split open, rust-red tendrils growing out of the windows into space.

places.name: Herdworld
traits: where Quill's escape pod came down
places.life: Huge shaggy tusked beasts and the smaller animals that ride in their fur.
places.background: Rolling plains with a dented escape pod half sunk in the grass and a herd on the horizon.

places.name: The Dying Corona
traits: a red star close to its end
places.life: Pilgrims of the order; cracked sun pieces carried as relics.
places.background: A huge cracked red-and-mustard star filling the sky, broken pieces circling it, heat as wavy ink lines.

places.name: Squall
traits: a calm layer where rafts hang from balloons
home of the draft hero Marl (docs/heroes.md, not in the game yet)
places.life: Long thin cloud swimmers and living lightning; the raft folk fish the lightning upwards out of the clouds and keep it in jars.
places.background: Dark storm bands in flat layers with a calm gap between them; small rafts hanging from balloons, kite lines rising into the clouds, lightning as jagged flat mustard shapes.
